definitions.explanation: A person who acts as an intermediary in arranging a marriage, and who traditionally serves as a ceremonial sponsor at the wedding. In traditional Japanese weddings, the matchmaker couple sits in a place of honor and assists throughout the ceremony.

examples.japanese: {媒酌人|ばいしゃくにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: To ask someone to be the matchmaker.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{媒酌人|ばいしゃくにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いした→お願いする：05654_onegaisuru⟧。
examples.english: We asked our boss to serve as the go-between.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{媒酌人|ばいしゃくにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てない→立てる：01196_tateru⟧⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, weddings without a go-between have become more common.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{媒酌|ばいしゃく}→媒酌：27036_baishaku⟧ (mediation; matchmaking) and ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ (person). The {媒酌人|ばいしゃくにん} traditionally plays two roles: arranging the match (⟦{見合|みあ}い→見合い：14159_miai⟧) and presiding over the wedding ceremony as a respected sponsor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {媒酌人|ばいしゃくにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to have a go-between (at a wedding)
- {媒酌人|ばいしゃくにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧: to ask someone to be the matchmaker
- {媒酌人|ばいしゃくにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧: matchmaker's speech (at the wedding)
- {媒酌人|ばいしゃくにん}⟦{夫妻|ふさい}→夫妻：00047_fusai⟧: the matchmaker couple

CULTURAL NOTE:
The role of {媒酌人|ばいしゃくにん} has declined significantly in modern Japan. In the past, most marriages were ⟦{見合|みあ}い→見合い：14159_miai⟧ (arranged), and a {媒酌人|ばいしゃくにん} was essential. Even as love marriages (⟦{恋愛|れんあい}→恋愛：12634_renai⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧) became the norm, couples sometimes asked a senior figure to serve as ceremonial {媒酌人|ばいしゃくにん}. Today, many weddings omit this role entirely.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{仲人|なこうど}→仲人：16691_nakoudo⟧: matchmaker; go-between — largely synonymous, but ⟦{仲人|なこうど}→仲人：16691_nakoudo⟧ is the more common everyday term
- {世話役|せわやく}: coordinator; organizer — broader term for someone who helps arrange things, not limited to weddings
